method: Compile each CU with TDM-GCC 4.4.1-tdm-1/-tdm-2 across a flag matrix (-O0/O1/O2/O3/Os x with/without -fomit-frame-pointer x default/-march=i686/-march=pentium; -mfpmath=387 always); slice each named function out of the resulting object by symbol-to-next-symbol; mask the objects own COFF relocation fields (dir32/rel32, 4 bytes) at the same offsets in both sides; compare byte-for-byte (masked) and by capstone mnemonic-sequence ratio against the original bytes embedded in assets/icytower15.exe.
file_offset_formula: file_offset = va - 0x400000 - 0x1000 + 0x400 = va - 0x400C00 (EXE has no .reloc section, fixed image base)
